profile_text.body:
Wix.com Ltd. is a public company headquartered in Tel Aviv and traded under the ticker WIX. Its own site presents it as a website builder: a free, easy-to-use tool for creating a website, offering more than 2,000 business-ready templates that can be customized manually or with AI, plus a custom domain. The company also says users can sell products, services and memberships from a single dashboard without plugins.

On the AI side, the site points to built-in AI tools within the builder and to specialized AI agents it says help keep a business growing. Beyond those descriptions, the material available does not detail specific AI products, model names, or research efforts.

The company's registration records list it as a for-profit public company with CIK 0001576789. No litigation, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.
